name: How is the cost of a whole-home interior paint job calculated?

mainEntity.name: How is the cost of a whole-home interior paint job calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on overall square footage, ceiling heights, wall condition, and the amount of trim or doors involved. Painting empty rooms costs less than furnished homes where crew members must move and cover furniture. If your walls require substantial drywall patching, water stain sealing, or texture smoothing prior to painting, prep time will increase the estimate. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra evaluates your layout and surfaces on-site to provide an upfront, itemized proposal covering labor, masking supplies, primer, and high-quality finish paints without unexpected add-ons.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pricing is based on home square footage, ceiling height, trim detail, prep needs like drywall repairs, and whether furniture must be moved and protected.
